reviewer: Assistant visual engineering inspection; non-blinded, not an independent human panel
scope: All 24 validation raw edit crops and matching composite crops in six saved contact sheets. No numerical realism probability inferred.
summary: The dark TuSimple seed-17 blotches become less severe, but visible discolored rectangles and texture mismatch remain. CULane strips remain conspicuous. All 24 inspected selected-student cases fail the strict no-conspicuous-artifact criterion; the required 90% acceptance is not met. Teacher composites can also show seams, so teacher fidelity is not itself proof of seamless realism.
